mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a strict completed four-hour BTC close crossover of the canonical fourteen-period McGinley Dynamic marks a trend transition after nonlinear speed adjustment for price displacement from the prior dynamic state; follow the new side for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when completed close-minus-McGinley crosses strictly from negative to positive; short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: KAMA adapts an EMA constant from path efficiency, HMA uses fixed weighted differences, and ordinary moving averages have price-independent speed. HVMD changes each recursive step by the fourth power of current price divided by prior dynamic state; it uses no prior parameter repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour nonlinear dynamic-state crossovers are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.dynamic: prior dynamic plus (completed close-prior dynamic)/(0.6*14*(completed close/prior dynamic)^4), finite positive denominator and reset across source gaps
features.initialization: first source-valid completed close after each gap, which cannot emit because close-minus-dynamic is zero
features.crossover: current completed close-minus-dynamic strict nonzero sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical McGinley Dynamic price crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no dynamic period, constant, power, initialization, crossover, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John R. McGinley canonical McGinley Dynamic convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: MD=current prior MD+(close-prior MD)/(0.6*14*(close/prior MD)^4), initialized at first valid completed close; trade strict close crossover
external_basis.selection_use: published length 14, adjustment constant 0.6, fourth-power ratio, and trend crossover interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes
